name: Arcane
description: Amid the stark discord of twin cities Piltover and Zaun, two sisters fight on rival sides of a war between magic technologies and clashing convictions.

videos.title: Making Mel
videos.overview: A multi-disciplinary look at creating a brand new character in the League of Legends universe.

videos.title: "Happy Progress Day!" Scene Breakdown
videos.overview: Breaking down Episode 4 through the lens of concept design and artistic direction with Arnaud Baudry and Julien Georgel.

videos.title: "When These Walls Come Tumbling Down" Scene Breakdown
videos.overview: Animation Director Bart Maunoury breaks down the animation of Episode 6.

videos.title: Ekko vs Jinx: Scene Breakdown
videos.overview: An in depth breakdown of the fight between Ekko and Jinx through a lens of animation, writing, and voice acting.

videos.title: "The Monster You Created" Scene Breakdown
videos.overview: Directors Arnaud Delord and Pascal Charrue close out Season 1 by dissecting the Dinner Party scene.

videos.title: Arcane Afterglow: Act I
videos.overview: Ella Purnell (Jinx) and Hailee Steinfeld (Vi) chat with Arcane writer Christian Linke about Jinx's inner monster, Vi and Caitlyn's kiss, Jinx and Sevika's relationship, Jayce and Viktor's rift, the reveal about Ambessa, and unanswered questions from Season 2 Act I.

videos.title: Arcane Afterglow: Act 2
videos.overview: Ella Purnell (Jinx), Hailee Steinfeld (Vi), Reed Shannon (Ekko), and Christian Linke are back in a Q&A with the creatives behind season 2. Listen in about their character arcs, the animation process, and the deeper meanings in the newest chapter of Jinx & Vi's story in the League of Legends universe.

videos.title: Arcane Afterglow: Act 3
videos.overview: Pour one out with Arcane season 2 stars Hailee Steinfeld, Ella Purnell, Reed Shannon, and co-creators Christian Linke & Alex Yee as they discuss season 2 spoilers, shocking character fates, and what they envision for the future of the Arcane universe.

videos.title: Bridging the Rift: I Only Dream in Risky
videos.overview: Every great idea sounds a little bit crazy at first. This is how it all began for Arcane.

videos.title: Bridging the Rift: Persistence (Or When Your Best Still Sucks)
videos.overview: The course of art never did run smooth. Meet some of the folks who helped pull Arcane through its darkest days.

videos.title: Bridging the Rift: Killstreaks Meet Keyframes
videos.overview: From paper to post-production, see how Fortiche captured the heart and soul of Arcane on screen.

videos.title: Bridging the Rift: Musical Misfits
videos.overview: Renowned musical talent from across the industry assemble to fill the world of Arcane with sound.

videos.title: Bridging the Rift: We Gave It Our Best Shot
videos.overview: 6 years later, every frame, note, and hope is polished and ready for the release of Arcane Season 1.

videos.title: Inside the Writer's Room: Reshuffling the Cards
videos.overview: A reflection on Act 1 with Arcane Showrunner and Co-Creator Christian Linke, Writer Amanda Overton, and Directors Pascal Charrue, Arnaud Delord, and Bart Maunoury.

videos.title: The Voices In My Head: Crafting the Performances
videos.overview: Voice Director Amanda Wyatt joins cast members Ella Purnell, Hailee Steinfeld, Katy Townsend, Kevin Alejandro, Mick Wingert, Reed Shannon, and Stewart Scudamore to discuss their process with character building in voice acting.

videos.title: Artist Breakdown: Act 1
videos.overview: Aurélien Ressencourt (2D FX Lead), Guillaume Degroote (2D FX Supervisor), Yann Leroy (Compositing Supervisor), Boris Cailly (Layout Artist), and Pauline Motard (Layout Supervisor)

videos.title: Art Gallery
videos.overview: A collection of concept art for characters, props, and backgrounds that give an inside look into the creation of Arcane: League of Legends – Season 2.

videos.title: Inside the Writer's Room: Beauty and Tragedy
videos.overview: A reflection on Act 2 with Arcane Showrunner and Co-Creator Christian Linke, Writer Amanda Overton, and Directors Pascal Charrue, Arnaud Delord, and Bart Maunoury.

videos.title: A Sonic Ballet
videos.overview: Alex Seaver (Executive Music Producer and Co-Composer), Alexander Temple (Co-Composer), and Sound Supervisors Brad Beaumont and Eliot Connors discuss the harmony between the composition of Arcane Season 2’s score and sound design.

videos.title: Artist Breakdown: Act 2
videos.overview: Bart Maunoury (Co-Director), Pascal Charrue (Co-Director), and Arnaud Delord (Co-Director)

videos.title: Music Videos
videos.overview: Full music videos for “Ma Meilleure Ennemie,” “Blood, Sweat & Tears,” and “Paint the Town Blue.”

videos.title: Inside the Writer's Room: What Could've Been
videos.overview: A reflection on Act 3 with Arcane Showrunner and Co-Creator Christian Linke, Writer Amanda Overton, and Directors Pascal Charrue, Arnaud Delord, and Bart Maunoury.

videos.title: Artist Breakdown: Act 3
videos.overview: Zhephing Xu (Storyboarder), Adam Bachiri (3D FX Supervisor), and Simon Magnan (3D Environment Artist)

videos.title: Going Another Way
videos.overview: Creatives at Riot and Fortiche provide an expansive look at the creation of a unique episode: “Pretend Like It’s the First Time.”

videos.title: Storyboards & Animatics
videos.overview: A collection of storyboards and animatics showing the early stages of some memorable moments from Season 2.

videos.title: Welcome to the Playground
videos.overview: Orphaned sisters Vi and Powder bring trouble to Zaun's underground streets in the wake of a heist in posh Piltover.

videos.title: Some Mysteries Are Better Left Unsolved
videos.overview: Idealistic inventor Jayce attempts to harness magic through science—despite his mentor's warnings. Criminal kingpin Silco tests a powerful substance.

videos.title: The Base Violence Necessary for Change
videos.overview: An epic showdown between old rivals results in a fateful moment for Zaun. Jayce and Viktor risk it all for their research.

videos.title: Happy Progress Day!
videos.overview: With Piltover prospering from their tech, Jayce and Viktor weigh their next move. A familiar face re-emerges from Zaun to wreak havoc.

videos.title: Everybody Wants to Be My Enemy
videos.overview: Rogue enforcer Caitlyn tours the undercity to track down Silco. Jayce puts a target on his back trying to root out Piltover corruption.

videos.title: When These Walls Come Tumbling Down
videos.overview: An eager protégé undermines his mentor on the council as a magical tech rapidly evolves. With authorities in pursuit, Jinx must face her past.

videos.title: The Boy Savior
videos.overview: Caitlyn and Vi meet an ally in Zaun’s streets and head into a frenzied battle with a common foe. Viktor makes a dire decision.

videos.title: Oil and Water
videos.overview: Disowned heir Mel and her visiting mother trade combat tactics. Caitlyn and Vi forge an unlikely alliance. Jinx undergoes a startling change.

videos.title: The Monster You Created
videos.overview: Perilously close to war, the leaders of Piltover and Zaun reach an ultimatum. But a fateful standoff changes both cities forever.

videos.title: Heavy Is the Crown
videos.overview: Vi and Caitlyn wrestle with how best to respond in the wake of a terrible tragedy that claims lives — and escalates tensions between the twin cities.

videos.title: Watch It All Burn
videos.overview: With Piltover ready for war, the Undercity weighs its options. Jinx lies low and plots her next move. A pivotal conversation takes place.

videos.title: Finally Got the Name Right
videos.overview: Caitlyn doubles down on her hunt for Jinx. Ambessa accepts a fateful meeting. Changes in Zaun lead to a shocking discovery.

videos.title: Paint the Town Blue
videos.overview: As rumors of Jinx's return swirl, Ambessa pursues her target with renewed enthusiasm. Jinx and Sevika go undercover and into the belly of the beast.

videos.title: Blisters and Bedrock
videos.overview: Vi awakens to surprising news. An unsettling reunion isn't what it seems. Caitlyn uncovers the origins of Shimmer.

videos.title: The Message Hidden Within the Pattern
videos.overview: Healing comes from a familiar face — in an unfamiliar place. A stunning betrayal threatens to change countless lives.

videos.title: Pretend Like It's the First Time
videos.overview: A moment of darkness, a moment of light — and a vision of What Could Have Been.

videos.title: Killing Is a Cycle
videos.overview: A brewing storm fuels a series of startling transformations. Elsewhere, the spark of rebellion still burns.

videos.title: The Dirt Under Your Nails
videos.overview: Magic. Science. Power. Revenge. Destinies clash in an epic final chapter, igniting an all-out war.

awards: Won 8 Primetime Emmys. 41 wins & 13 nominations total
